data.title: Follow the trams up, then let the river pull you west
data.intro: A strong Lisbon day starts uphill in Graça, eases down through Alfama, takes shade in a museum courtyard after lunch, and ends near the water at Santos.

data.title: Ride Tram 28 before 9 am, then move west before the heat settles in
data.body: The miradouros fill quickly. Graça at 8am is peaceful; by 11am it’s a different experience entirely. Budget 40 minutes for the tram, then head downhill at your own pace.

data.title: Alfama rooftops and river club check-in
data.summary: A riverside hotel, tram pass, and a private food-led walk through Alfama and Mouraria. Breakfast included.

data.quote: The food tour alone was worth the trip. They took us to a tasca that’s been on the same street since 1961 — no menu, just what they cook that day.
